title: STRIDE: Strategic Iterative Decision-Making for Retrieval-Augmented Multi-Hop Question Answering
authors: Wei Chen; Lili Zhao; Zhi Zheng; HuiJun Hou; Tong Xu
why_relevant: STRIDE addresses iterative RAG for multi-hop QA with dynamic decisions on when to retrieve vs infer, touching tangentially on retrieval control and error propagation.
why_not_or_caveat: Focus is on planning/decomposition for MHQA, not robustness to noise, conflict, adversaries, or calibration per se.
